reason: It names my exact problem, and 900 euro is not the issue at our size, but I would be the second client of a man who does this evenings and weekends and whose only reference is still inside his 60-day pilot. I have spent thirty years not being anyone's test case.
objection: The farmer I drove to yesterday did not have the document at all; his daughter handles his WhatsApp and the APIA paper was in a drawer in another village. A reminder link does not make a paper exist, and I do not believe my farmers will photograph a 12-page lease legibly from a phone, so I would still be driving, now with a dashboard telling me what I already know.
would_change_my_mind: A phone call with the Bihor consultant after his 60 days, telling me in his own words that his farmer and SME dossiers closed measurably faster and that his clients actually used the link without him calling them anyway.
